clue.text: 'RIP' mistakenly put by female icon or diva

indicators.note: done mistakenly, the three letters of the quoted word are set down in the wrong order

parts.note: Madonna is the pop star, a female icon if ever there was one

explanation.surface: A star singer is wrongly written off with a premature 'RIP' beside her name.
explanation.walkthrough: 'female icon' suggests a religious image of the Virgin Mary; here it is the pop star. 'mistakenly' scrambles the quoted letters to PRI.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: both name a temperamental leading lady, especially a star soprano.

clue.text: Agents of the law quietly love bugs

parts.note: P is piano, the musical direction to play quietly
love is nil in tennis scoring, shaped like the letter O
lice are small parasitic insects, bugs

explanation.surface: Law enforcement agents quietly plant listening devices on someone's affair.
explanation.walkthrough: 'bugs' looks like a verb about surveillance; it is a noun for insects.
explanation.definitionFit: Collective noun: officers who enforce the law form the force that keeps public order.

clue.text: Reverse order, still welcoming victory

indicators.note: welcoming means one word takes another inside itself, as a host takes in a guest

parts.note: inert means motionless, still
V for victory, as in the V sign

explanation.surface: A team keeps order unchanged while celebrating a win.
explanation.definitionFit: Verb sense: to turn something upside down or put it in the opposite sequence.

clue.text: In a chaotic state, crazily has to help welcoming mistress?

indicators.note: welcoming means the jumbled letters take another word inside them
crazily says the letters of the three words are jumbled wildly

parts.note: a mistress is a lover in an affair

explanation.surface: Someone frantically has to help while also entertaining a secret lover.
explanation.walkthrough: 'crazily' turns HAS TO HELP into AL...THESHOP, and 'welcoming' puts LOVER in the gap.
explanation.definitionFit: British idiom: utterly disorganised, scattered everywhere in a mess.

clue.text: Manager of revolutionary region as source of rumours

indicators.note: revolutionary suggests overturning, so the letters of two words are turned into a new order
the source of a word is where it starts, its first letter

explanation.surface: The boss of a rebel territory is also where all the gossip comes from.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: someone who arranges and runs things is a manager.

clue.text: Numbers thrown out of station in Essex

indicators.note: thrown out of says letters are ejected from the run of words that follows, so they lie inside it

explanation.surface: Passengers are ejected in numbers from a railway station in Essex, a county east of London.
explanation.definitionFit: Plural noun: each is the numeral after eight, so together they are numbers.

clue.text: Henry following daughter's vegetarian recipe?

indicators.note: following means the second piece comes after the first

parts.note: Hal is the familiar form of Henry, as for Shakespeare's Prince Hal

explanation.surface: Henry copies his daughter's meat-free dish.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: a spiced lentil dish, a classic of meatless Indian cooking, hence the question mark.

clue.text: Support Reds, playing in high temperature

indicators.note: in places the jumbled letters inside the other word

parts.note: heat is high temperature

indicators.note: playing suggests the letters are at play, moving about into a new order

explanation.surface: Fans back the Reds as they play on a sweltering day.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Support' looks like cheering on a football team nicknamed the Reds; 'playing' makes DRES, which 'in' sets inside the heat.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: a cushioned rest behind a seated person's head is a support.

clue.text: Cool book on fighting millions

parts.note: Luke is a book of the New Testament
war is fighting
M is the abbreviation for million(s)

explanation.surface: A detached verdict on a book about warfare that sold millions.
explanation.walkthrough: In a down clue 'book on fighting' places LUKE above WAR.
explanation.definitionFit: Figurative synonym: unenthusiastic, half-hearted, as a cool reception is tepid.

clue.text: Sweet cupid needs a wok for cooking

indicators.note: cooking suggests the ingredients are mixed up, so these letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Cupid, the god of love, needs a wok to make his dessert.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: a sponge baked with fruit at the bottom then turned out is a dessert, a British sweet.

clue.text: Come clean, either way

indicators.note: either way says the word reads the same forwards or backwards

parts.note: these definition words give the whole answer, and the answer is itself the palindrome: it reads the same from either end

explanation.surface: Someone is urged to confess, whichever way things go.
explanation.definitionFit: Idiom: to be honest and frank with someone, as in 'level with me'.

clue.text: Keep quiet about new plot before king gets access to ship

indicators.note: about means one word goes around another

parts.note: to gag someone is to keep them quiet
a plan is a plot or scheme
K is king in chess notation

explanation.surface: A conspirator hushes up a fresh scheme before the king can board.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: a movable plank used as a walkway is how people get aboard a vessel.

clue.text: Two vehicles sandwiching a third?

indicators.note: sandwiching means two pieces hold another between them like bread round a filling

parts.note: two vehicles are a car and a van

explanation.surface: A puzzle of traffic: one vehicle wedged between two others.
explanation.walkthrough: 'a third' hints at the whole: the result is itself a vehicle, the trailer home towed behind a car.
explanation.definitionFit: A towed trailer home is itself a vehicle, the third of the clue's picture.

clue.text: Work is scheduled across Germany for the poorest city area

indicators.note: across means the jumbled letters stretch across another
scheduled suggests the letters are rearranged into a set order

parts.note: D is the international vehicle code for Germany

explanation.surface: Building work is planned all over Germany to improve its worst neighbourhoods.
explanation.walkthrough: 'scheduled' turns WORK IS into SKI...ROW, and 'across' straddles D.
explanation.definitionFit: Americanism: a run-down district where down-and-outs and the destitute live.

clue.text: Go over set of drawers for pantomime dame, perhaps

parts.note: to cross is to go over
a dresser is a piece of furniture with drawers

explanation.surface: Someone steps over a chest of drawers dressed as a pantomime dame.
explanation.walkthrough: A pantomime dame is a comic woman's part in British Christmas pantomime, played by a man in drag.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: a man playing the comic female role wears women's clothing.

clue.text: Detracted from French staff outside entrance

parts.note: de is French for from

indicators.note: outside means one word goes around another

parts.note: a rod is a staff or stick
a gate is an entrance

explanation.surface: Something took away from a French staff gathered outside an entrance.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Detracted from' reads as one phrase, but 'from' goes with 'French'.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: to belittle or take away from something's worth or standing.

clue.text: House flooding after start of deluge

indicators.note: after means the second piece follows the first
the start of a word is its first letter

parts.note: welling is rising and flooding out, as water

explanation.surface: A home is inundated after the downpour begins.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: a place where someone lives is a residence or home.

clue.text: Holiday worker left before end of day, without paying attention

parts.note: vac is short for vacation, a holiday
a worker ant is the usual crossword worker

indicators.note: the end of a word is its last letter

explanation.surface: A holiday employee clocked off before the day was out, not concentrating.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: blankly, absent-mindedly, with an empty look.

clue.text: How a free port must work to provide elementary protection?

indicators.note: work suggests the letters are worked over and rearranged

explanation.surface: A tax-free port must operate to shelter basic needs.
explanation.walkthrough: 'elementary' refers to the elements, wind and rain, not to basics.
explanation.definitionFit: Verb sense: to make something resistant to wind and rain, the elements.

clue.text: Importance of women on crew

parts.note: an eight is a rowing crew

explanation.surface: The value of having women in a crew.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: significance or influence, as in carrying weight.

clue.text: Bishop settled on that man being unconcerned

parts.note: B is bishop in chess notation
lit means settled or alighted, as a bird
he is that man

explanation.surface: A bishop has landed on some man who seems carefree.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: carefree and casual, showing no worry.

clue.text: Trouble returns in so stormy a relationship

indicators.note: returns means the word goes back the way it came, read backwards

parts.note: to ail is to trouble

indicators.note: stormy suggests the letters are tossed about into a new order

explanation.surface: Trouble keeps recurring in such a turbulent affair.
explanation.walkthrough: 'returns' turns AIL into LIA; 'stormy' makes ISON from IN SO.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: an affair or a working connection between parties.

clue.text: French resort accommodating English relative

indicators.note: accommodating means one word holds another inside, like a hotel guest

parts.note: Nice is a resort on the French Riviera

explanation.surface: A Riviera resort puts up an English family member.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: a sibling's daughter is a family member.

clue.text: Well-bred chap confronting devious character

parts.note: gent is short for gentleman, a chap
an eel is slippery, a devious character

explanation.surface: A refined man faces up to a slippery rogue.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: polite and refined, of good social standing.

clue.text: Shy type may be home and dry when dog's collared

parts.note: in means at home

indicators.note: collared means one word wraps round another like a collar round a neck

parts.note: TT is teetotal, dry
Rover is a stock name for a dog

explanation.surface: A timid person might be home and safe once the dog is on its lead.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: a reserved, inward-looking person is shy.

clue.text: Such language skill must incorporate work

indicators.note: incorporate means one word takes another into its body

parts.note: art is skill
to go is to work, function

explanation.surface: Linguistic skill has to involve effort.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: jargon or slang of a particular group is a kind of language.

clue.text: Ropes in blokes

definitions.meaning: ropes or cables steadying a tent or mast
informal word for men or chaps

explanation.definitionFit: Two senses: tent ropes and men, both the same word.

clue.text: A decent red fermenting, bang on target

indicators.note: fermenting suggests the letters are bubbling and changing into a new order

explanation.surface: A good red wine ferments perfectly on schedule.
explanation.definitionFit: Idiom: the exact middle, precisely where one aims.
